items.label: Executive Summary
items.name: Executive Summary
items.paragraph:
A *highly motivated* and *innovative* Senior UX Architect and Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience crafting *modular design systems* and *premium web experiences*. Specializes in balancing technical feasibility with aesthetic elegance to build solutions that users *love*.

Demonstrated history of leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact software products with *vibrant design aesthetics* and clean UI architectures.

items.label: Harvard University - School of Design
bullets: Graduated _summa cum laude_ with honors thesis on *accessible product architectures*.
Mentored under Prof. Marcus Vance in *Advanced User Interface Systems*.

items.label: Lead Product Designer (Forge Studio)
items.name: Lead Product Designer
items.subtitle: Forge Studio
details: Led a cross-functional team of *8 engineers* and *3 designers* to ship a modern SaaS editor.
Shipped *12 premium resume templates* in *React/Vanilla CSS*, boosting signups by *45%*.
Crafted *interactive micro-interactions* that improved active user retention by *18%*.

items.label: Senior UI/UX Designer (Design Guild)
items.name: Senior UI/UX Designer
items.subtitle: Design Guild
details: Designed complex B2B dashboards with *dense data visualization* and customizable widgets.
Established the company’s first unified *Design Token System*, reducing frontend handoff time by *30%*.
Conducted *30+ deep-dive user interviews* to restructure core navigation workflows.

items.label: ResumeForge App
items.name: ResumeForge App
items.subtitle: Open-Source Creator
details: Created a client-side *modular builder* utilizing *Dnd-kit* for smooth drag-and-drop actions.
Implemented instant *PDF rendering* in *jsPDF* with real-time preview updating.
Engineered *smart overflow detection* and dynamic section layout balancing.

items.label: Technical & Design Proficiencies
items.name: Technical & Design Proficiencies
details: *Core Design:* Figma, design tokens, *micro-animations*, glassmorphic UI, responsive layouts
*Web Development:* HTML5, CSS3 Flexbox/Grid, Javascript (ES6+), React, *TailwindCSS*
*Product Strategy:* Rapid prototyping, A/B testing, user journey mapping, usability testing
